title: Early jazz bands and fellow clarinetists Tio and Baquet
summary: Picou says he helped lead the move to jazz bands; Lorenzo Tio and George Baquet were the only three clarinetists of his standing, playing funerals together.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: And do you remember when musicians that you were playing with yourself first started to call themselves jazz bands? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. Yeah. But I was one of the leader. You know? Sure. That led them to that. Yeah. True jazz. Did you have any connection, any friendly connection or anything with some of the other clarinet players in those times like Lorenzo and I was playing with the jazz?
Yeah. George Bacchia. Yeah. George Bacchia. Yes. Lorenzo Tio and George Bacchia. We were the only three clarinet players in your league.
They could do that kind of stuff. Because we used to play at funerals and everything.
